npc_agna_reeve.name: Agna
npc_agna_reeve.look: A small, sharp-eyed old woman in her late sixties with white hair under a linen coif, a dark brown wool dress, a grey shawl and a carved hazel stick across her knees.
npc_agna_reeve.personality: Shrewd, patient and dry; hears everything that happens in the hamlet by sundown and judges people by what their neighbours say of them, not by what they say of themselves.
npc_agna_reeve.values: the hamlet's peace, hospitality to the deserving, plain truth
npc_agna_reeve.fears: thieves, fire, the hamlet falling out with itself
npc_agna_reeve.authority: The hamlet's reeve: she settles quarrels and keeps the guest-stick.
npc_agna_reeve.concerns: A stranger on the green. She'll wait to hear what the neighbours make of them before she says much.

guest_stick.text: Whoever carries the hamlet's guest-stick is fed and housed by any household here.
guest_stick.line: This? The guest-stick. Whoever carries it eats at any table in Oakley.
guest_stick.lead: Whoever carries Oakley's guest-stick is fed and housed by anyone there.

road.text: The lane runs south to the ferry over the Wend.
road.line: Lane goes south to Gorm's ferry. If he'll take you.
road.lead: Oakley's lane runs south to Gorm's ferry over the Wend.

npc_agna_reeve.persuaded_by: what her neighbours tell her of you, and what she sees you do
npc_agna_reeve.style: Few words, dry humour, long silences; never asks a question she can find out by waiting.

samples: We'll see what the neighbours say.
Cob says you're handy. Cob doesn't say much.
Sit, if you like. Talk is free.
The stick goes to those who've earned a good word here.
voice.habits: Watches the green from her bench; nods slowly; hears the gossip first.
voice.never: gives the guest-stick on a stranger's own word
voice.greeting: Looks you over without getting up: 'A stranger. Hm.'

goals: Hear what the neighbours make of the stranger
npc_agna_reeve.likes: good gossip, honest folk, quiet evenings

tasks.doing: sitting on her bench, watching the green

superstition.text: Agna would want to know how it works.

npc_agna_reeve.decides: Agna gives the guest-stick to a stranger her neighbours speak well of, or who she has seen do real good here. Never on their own word.

npc_cob_woodman.name: Cob
npc_cob_woodman.look: A big, quiet man in his forties with a bushy brown beard, a battered felt hat, a leather jerkin over a russet shirt, and sawdust on his sleeves.
npc_cob_woodman.personality: Slow-spoken, practical and honest; says little and means all of it.
npc_cob_woodman.values: good tools, a day's work, his neighbours
npc_cob_woodman.concerns: His axe handle split this morning and he can't work until he has a new one. There's a good ash stave by his woodpile, but he's no hand at shaping.

agna.text: Agna gives the guest-stick to strangers the neighbours speak well of.
agna.line: Agna listens to us. Do right by folk here and she'll hear of it.
agna.lead: Agna gives the guest-stick to strangers the neighbours speak well of.

npc_cob_woodman.style: Short sentences; grunts; a slow smile when pleased.

samples: Handle's split. Useless.
You any good with a knife?
That's good work. I'll tell Agna.
Hm.
voice.habits: Turns the broken axe over in his hands; talks to the woodpile.

superstition.text: Cob would want to know how it works.

offers.task: shape a new axe handle from the ash stave and fit his axe head on it
offers.check: Has the stranger made Cob a new axe handle?

npc_liss_weaver.name: Liss
npc_liss_weaver.look: A slight young woman of twenty with freckles and a long red plait, a blue linen dress with the sleeves pushed up, a rag tied round her left hand and wool fluff caught in her hair.
npc_liss_weaver.personality: Friendly, talkative and a terrible keeper of secrets: anything she hears, the whole hamlet hears by evening.
npc_liss_weaver.values: her little brother, her loom, a good story
npc_liss_weaver.fears: her hand going bad, falling behind on the cloth
npc_liss_weaver.concerns: She cut her hand on the shears and it won't stop bleeding through the rag; she can't weave like this.

news.text: Everyone in Oakley meets at the well; news gets round by sundown.
news.line: Oh, nothing stays secret here. Say it at the well and Agna knows by supper.
news.lead: News in Oakley travels from the well to Agna by sundown.

npc_liss_weaver.style: Quick and chatty; jumps between subjects.

samples: Oh, it's nothing, it's only a cut. Well. It's quite a cut.
Tib! Come here!
Wait till I tell Agna.
You're kind. Most travellers aren't.
voice.habits: Talks with her hands (and winces); calls for Tib.
voice.greeting: Waves with her good hand: 'Hello! You're new.'

tasks.doing: at her door, nursing her hand

superstition.text: Liss would want to know how it works.

npc_fenn_old.name: Fenn
npc_fenn_old.look: A stooped, very old man with wisps of white hair, a big nose, a patched brown smock, a blanket round his shoulders and a walking stick.
npc_fenn_old.personality: Cheerful, deaf in one ear and endlessly grateful; tells the same three stories.
npc_fenn_old.values: a warm hearth, company, the old days
npc_fenn_old.concerns: His fire's nearly out and his knees won't take him to the wood. He won't ask.

oak.text: There are fallen branches under the oak on the green, free for anyone.
oak.line: Branches under the old oak. Free. If a body could bend to pick them up.
oak.lead: Free fallen branches lie under the oak on Oakley green.

samples: Eh? Speak up.
When I was a lad, the winters were proper winters.
Bless you. Bless you.
I'll tell everyone. Everyone!
voice.habits: Cups his good ear; blesses people; tells everyone everything.
voice.greeting: Squints: 'Eh? A visitor! Come in, come in, mind the step.'

tasks.doing: sitting on his doorstep in a blanket

superstition.text: Fenn would want to know how it works.

npc_tib_child.name: Tib
npc_tib_child.look: A skinny, scruffy boy of about ten with a mop of red hair, a dirty face, a too-big tunic belted with string and bare muddy feet.
npc_tib_child.personality: Nosy, quick and fearless; runs between houses all day and carries every bit of news.
npc_tib_child.values: news, sweets, being first to tell
npc_tib_child.concerns: Finding out who the stranger is before anyone else does.

stick.text: Agna gives her guest-stick to strangers the neighbours speak well of.
stick.line: If you want Agna's stick, get people saying nice things about you. That's how.
stick.lead: Agna gives her guest-stick to strangers the neighbours speak well of.

samples: Who are you? Where are you from? Is that a sword?
I'll tell Agna!
Liss cut her hand. There was loads of blood.
Can I carry that?
voice.habits: Runs everywhere; listens at doors; reports to Agna.
voice.greeting: Skids to a stop: 'Who are you?'

superstition.text: Tib would want to know how it works.
